argument: The delayed return must be carried by downstream route displacement and pressure-sensitive width; a seam mark or bright pool cannot do the explanatory work alone.

With notation and seam witnesses hidden, a caption-free viewer should find one family of strokes that bends and comes back on a shared shifted course. If only a local kink remains, the mutation fails.
Pointer and Enter/Space must create the same bounded seam, while lifting the latest seam must restore the exact prior routes and pressure values.
A delayed return is an easy metaphor. Delete v006 if the route geometry cannot be distinguished from a generic wobbly brush, or if the prose explains more memory than the marks visibly carry.
